about.title: Hi, I'm Joanna.
about.lead: I help leaders find the words for the work they already do — and build the rooms where those words land.
about.body: I've spent two decades on stages and in private rooms with founders, executives, and women rebuilding their voice after the company they built outgrew the person they used to be. What I teach isn't speaking. It's the moment — the one that shaped what you actually know, and how to say it so people trust you immediately.
about.quote: Influence is not a volume problem. It's a clarity problem.

timeline.text: First stage. Terrified. Discovered story-mining by accident.
Started coaching one woman in a café. Then a hundred.
First True Influence retreat — 8 women, one room, real results.
The method became the curriculum. 300+ leaders guided.

journey.title: How I found the work.
journey.lead: The short version. The longer one I tell on stage.

chapters.text: I was good at speaking. I was bad at being heard. There is a difference and it cost me a decade.
A woman across a café asked me one question. I told her a story I had never said out loud. She cried. So did I. That was the moment I knew what I actually do.

Eight women, four days, one room. No slides. No framework. Just the moment each of them had been talking around for years. They left with a voice the room could feel. I have been running the method ever since.
Hundreds of leaders. Stages, boardrooms, kitchens at 11pm. The work is the same. The story behind your solution is the only thing that makes you trusted.
You. Whatever moment you have been talking around — let us name it.

journey.closerQuote: Influence is not a volume problem. It is a clarity problem.

stories.title: The receipts.
stories.lead: Real women, real results — across every phase of the method.

items.name: Maya
items.body: I came in unsure of my voice. I left with a message I could repeat — and three booked stages within six weeks.

items.name: Renée
items.quote: Got the board to listen, finally.
items.body: Twenty years of context-setting in meetings. Joanna helped me cut to the moment. The board moved on the next pitch.

items.name: Jules
items.body: I had been doing free stages for two years. After Phase 1 I priced my talk — and somebody paid it the first time I sent it out.

items.name: Devi
items.quote: Paid for itself in one introduction.
items.body: Sat next to a network exec at the retreat. Two months later, my show was greenlit. None of that happens without the message I built that week.

items.name: Aiyana
items.body: I had been telling the same origin story for ten years. Joanna found the one underneath it. I rebuilt the whole brand around what I actually do differently.

items.name: Sara
items.quote: The clearest yes I have ever given myself.
items.body: The first time I felt my own voice in a room — instead of an executive translation of myself — was at this retreat.
